title: NHTSA 22V744000 — Rivian Automotive, LLC (EDV / R1S / R1T)

campaign.Summary: Rivian Automotive, LLC (Rivian) is recalling certain 2022 R1T, R1S, and EDV vehicles.  The fastener connecting the front upper control arm and steering knuckle may have been improperly tightened.
campaign.Consequence: A loose steering knuckle fastener could separate, causing a loss of vehicle control and increasing the risk of a crash.
campaign.Remedy: Dealers will inspect and, as necessary, tighten the steering knuckle fastener, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed November 11, 2022.  Owners may contact Rivian customer service at 1-888-748-4261.  Rivian's number for this recall is FSAM 997.
campaign.Notes: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.
